content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There are 2 posts of Security Guard / Night Guard (Female). Selected candidates are engaged as individual service providers, not as regular employees. Only women candidates will be engaged. The candidate must have passed 8th from any recognized board and have at least 2 years' experience of working as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district/state level. She should preferably be retired military/para-military personnel. No relaxation is given in the mandatory educational qualification. The experience certificate must be a full-time experience certificate issued by the employer of the institution concerned, attested or verified by a gazetted officer. A certificate of voluntary service of any kind is not accepted as experience. To get the benefit of experience, a copy of the appointment order must be attached; otherwise the benefit of experience cannot be given. The decision of the appointing authority, the District Collector, on accepting experience is final. The candidate's age on 01 January 2026 of the year of selection must not be less than 21 years and not more than 35 years. With all relaxations given under State Government instructions issued from time to time, the maximum age limit will not be more than 45 years. Age is verified from the birth certificate or the class 8th mark sheet showing the date of birth. The candidate must be a native (मूल निवासी) of Chhattisgarh; only a residence certificate issued by a competent authority is accepted. Knowledge of the local language/dialect is necessary. A candidate who married before the minimum age prescribed for marriage is not eligible; a selected candidate must give an affidavit on this on Rs. 50 stamp paper attested by a notary. A candidate who married a person who already has a living spouse is not eligible; the Government may exempt a case if satisfied that there are sufficient reasons. Employees of government/semi-government institutions must submit their application with the employer's No Objection Certificate; otherwise the application will not be considered. A non-conviction certificate must be submitted at the time of applying. The service fee is Rs. 11360 per month (Level-1). Only the lump sum service fee is paid; no other pay, allowances or ex-gratia grant is payable. The service fee follows the limits and instructions of the Government of India, and will be raised only if the Government of India raises it. The first engagement is for a maximum of 2 years; after that the District Collector may extend it by 1 year each time, based on work ability, efficiency, conduct, department need and the controlling officer's recommendation. If not extended, the engagement ends on its own. The engagement is fully temporary and may be ended without giving reasons; either side may end it with one month's notice or one month's pay instead. content_sections.heading: WCD Bastar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Security Guard/Night Guard will work in shifts to provide 24 hour service at OSC. The Security Guard/Night Guard would be responsible for the overall security of OSC. She/he would be responsible for safety of all capital assets, furniture and equipment at OSC.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application must be submitted in the prescribed format (printed with the notice) at the district office on the walk-in date. Certificates, mark sheets and other documents must be attested by a gazetted officer or self-attested, and the originals with self-attested copies must be brought at the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: A district-level selection committee follows a marks-based system and recommends candidates to the District Collector, who is the appointing authority and issues the appointment orders. The marks are given as follows: From the merit list prepared on 80 marks, applicants are to be invited for the walk-in interview in a 1:10 ratio for each post. Knowledge of the local language/dialect is also judged during the walk-in interview. The final selection list is then prepared, and if candidates have equal marks, the older candidate gets preference. The decision of the District Collector on selection is final. No travel allowance or other allowance is paid for attending the walk-in interview.

rows.basis: Percentage in the minimum required educational qualification (100-mark weightage)
Each additional year of experience after the minimum experience (2 marks per year)
Bonus for work experience in the State women helpline or Sakhi One Stop Centre (2 marks per year)

faq.question: Q1. When is the WCD Bastar Security Guard / Night Guard walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026 from 10:30 AM at the Office of District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Jagdalpur, District Bastar.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Security Guard / Night Guard (Female) at the Sakhi One Stop Centre, Jagdalpur.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: The candidate must have passed 8th from any recognized board and have at least 2 years' experience as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district/state level; retired military/para-military personnel are preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must be not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years on 01 January 2026, and not more than 45 years with all relaxations under State Government instructions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Security Guard / Night Guard?
faq.answer: The post carries a lump sum service fee of Rs. 11360 per month (Level-1), with no other pay, allowances or ex-gratia grant.

faq.question: Q6. Can men apply for this post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says only women candidates will be engaged on these posts, and they must be natives of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A merit list is prepared on 80 marks (qualification percentage up to 60, extra experience up to 10, bonus for women helpline or One Stop Centre experience up to 10), followed by a walk-in interview of 20 marks.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should be brought to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the application in the prescribed format with originals and attested copies of the birth certificate, 5th and 8th mark sheets, experience certificate and NOC, Chhattisgarh residence certificate, caste certificate (as required) and a non-conviction certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is fully temporary, first for a maximum of 2 years, and may be extended by 1 year at a time by the District Collector.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no travel allowance or other allowance will be paid to candidates attending the walk-in interview.
